paragraphs.text: Against the rich who oppressed them.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: This is the complaint of the people, showing the extremity they were brought to.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: To pay our tribute to the king of the Persians, which was exacted yearly from us.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: By nature the rich are no better than the poor.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: We are not able to redeem them, but out of poverty are forced to sell them to others.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: You press them with usury, and seek to bring all thing into your hands.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Both because they should be moved with pity seeing how many were oppressed by them, and also hear the judgment of others, who should be witnesses of their dealings with their brethren.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Seeing God has once delivered them from the bondage of the heathen, shall we make them our slaves?
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Who by this occasion will blaspheme the Name of God, seeing that our actions are no better than theirs.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: reproach of the heathen our enemies

paragraphs.text: Which you take from them for the loan.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: I did not receive the portion and diet which the governors who were before me exacted, in which he declares that he rather sought the wealth of the people than his own convenience.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: While at other times they had by measure, at this time they had most liberally.
